notes.title: Update 1.1
notes.content:
[h1]Hey golfers![/h1]

It's time for another update! Just before Christmas, we have a bag full of exciting new features for you. Let's dive right in.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27663206/07d1f276e6a0e29baf732ab8491009a5ecf580b5.png[/img]

[h2]Audio Overhaul[/h2]

After seven years on the market, we finally realized that there were absolutely no sounds in the game. So we decided to dub the whole thing, figuring it was better late than never. Now you can hear everything - the sound of your golf ball rolling on different surfaces, hitting things, the sound of the environment, the user interface, and much more. It is a completely new, immersive journey to play our official maps. Not only that, but all the sounds are also available in our map editor. We can't wait to hear what you're going to create.

[h2]Grassland Visual Upgrade[/h2]

Our oldest and most iconic map is Grassland. It was created as part of our Steam Greenlight prototype and hasn't gotten much love since. That's why we've created over 150 new assets to make this map more visually appealing. Of course, all of these assets are also available to you in our editor.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/Ieez2eT.gif[/img]

[h2]Challenge System[/h2]

Sometimes a game against friends is not enough of a challenge. For those times, we've created an all-new challenge system. It will provide you with new challenges of varying difficulty every day. Completing these tasks will reward you with coins and items that are sometimes only available there. In our new shop, you can spend your hard-earned coins on skins, trails, hats and more.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/Jr1c4Eq.gif[/img]

[h2]Additional Swing Mechanic[/h2]

Staring at the same putter for over seven years gets pretty boring. That's why we've added a new type of equipable item - the putter. They are pretty rare, but be sure to check out your first Weekly Challenge, you just might be able to find one. To help you get even more enjoyment out of your brand new putter, we've decided to add a new, optional visual swing style. It's more like a swing and less like a train. Check our options and activate the rotational swing, but be careful, you might lose your skill.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/YXxB4En.gif[/img]

Have fun and take care,

Team Perfuse Entertainment

notes.title: Golf It! 1.0
notes.content:
[h1]Hey golfers! [/h1]

After six years and dozens of updates, we've decided to finally work on our bucket list and call it 1.0. Thank you for your incredible support, feedback, patience, and endless creativity. In six years, you've created more than 15000 unique maps, for which we are deeply grateful. It's been an incredible journey and it's not over yet. We're already working on our next update, so stay tuned.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27663206/f9df11dde54d48199b8f3ec5da1265413ea1dd72.png[/img]

[h2]New Map: Deep blue[/h2]
Update 1.0 sends you to the depths of a mystical ocean valley. Swim with fish, explore ancient ruins and master the physics of underwater golf.
[img]https://i.imgur.com/9yjQorW.gif[/img]
This theme consists of over 500 unique objects, special physics, and other mystical features. All of this will be available in our editor. We can't wait for your underwater creations. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27663206/803bd0a38258b23dd74b8b5e9f85a9cb9e1ce9c6.gif[/img]
[h2]New UI[/h2] 
Redesigning the user interface was one of the oldest items on our to-do list. As the game has grown over the years, this task has become even more important.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27663206/9343b9fb09f94d47247a7b83f32bb072ea057d8b.png[/img]
[h2]Terrain Editor[/h2]
Another item on our bucket list, but also a long-awaited request, is a detailed terrain editor. A brand-new set of tools based on voxel data that will allow you to turn that boring flat terrain into any landscape you can imagine.
[img]https://i.imgur.com/QA8QTda.gif[/img]
The toolset will be super easy to use - even on existing maps - and comes with different sculpting and painting modes.
[img]https://i.imgur.com/eX5DtUW.gif[/img]
[h2]Foliage Painter[/h2]
Another new and very useful editor tool is the Foliage Painter. As the name suggests, it allows you to easily paint foliage into your landscape based on a variety of settings. This will save you a lot of time and even help to create a more natural look. Of course, you can also paint anything else.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/9SdZNgr.gif[/img]

[h2]Codebase Overhaul[/h2]
Over the last year we have reworked almost the entire codebase, which has been by far the biggest challenge. It was essential to keep the game maintainable, ready for future features and to improve the overall quality of the game. Some visible results are lightning-fast load times, improved stability, and features like the new UI.

[h2]Gamepad Support[/h2]
Initially, our putter movement was designed to require skillful use of your mouse. Later on, we realised that gamepad support and an alternative shot option were essential for accessibility. With our new user interface, we now fully support gamepads from start to finish. In future updates we would also like to implement modes for colour-blind players.

We've also added an option to either hold or toggle the putter with the left mouse button or the right gamepad trigger. Feel free to try both methods as they may further enhance your experience.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27663206/07f3233dd5f80c2a8b1dc901a172beb81de6b7b8.png[/img]

[h2]Languages[/h2]
We are very proud that our game is played all over the world. We've supported many languages in the past, but often only partially. With this update, we've chosen 14 languages (Chinese, Czech, English, Finnish, French, German, Japanese, Korean, Portuguese, Russian, Spanish, Swedish, Turkish, Ukrainian). We may add more languages in the future if requested.

[h2]Price & Currency conversion[/h2]
Early on, we promised to keep the price at $8.99 per copy, even after we left Early Access. We are going to keep that promise, but for a few currencies we need to make an adjustment based on the conversion. This change will affect Argentinian Pesos, Russian Rubles, and Turkish Lira, and will take effect in a week's time.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27663206/978ee1d2fd3d4f5d1638fa8ead682fa89fb2846d.png[/img]

Because we've done a complete code and UI overhaul, we won't list every change. This should be seen as a list of highlights.

notes.title: Dev Log #3
notes.content:
[h1]Hey![/h1]
Two months later, we are still paving the way for Update 1.0 – it’s just about time for another Dev Log. Today we would like to present to you our newest official map. It’s built upon a brand new, gorgeous looking underwater theme, which will be release with Update 1.0.
[img]https://i.imgur.com/9yjQorW.gif[/img]
The underwater theme is going to be our largest theme with more than 500 unique objects, special physics and other mystical features. They will be available in our editor as always. We are super excited to see your creations.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27663206/803bd0a38258b23dd74b8b5e9f85a9cb9e1ce9c6.gif[/img]
Currently we are primarily fixing bugs and doing some quality-of-life improvements. With every week of progress, we are getting closer to leave early access. We know that you’ve waited a long time for this to happen, so we are working hard to finish the update.

[h2]FAQ[/h2]
[b]When will Update 1.0 be released?[/b]
As soon as we can name a date, we will share it with you. As we already mentioned in our last dev log, we did an extensive code overhaul. These measures were not planned at all, but as it turns out they were urgently necessary. The results justify the decision, and we know you’ll love it, but we had to spent way more time than we expected.

[b]Will Update 1.0 be the last update?[/b]
Not at all - we have already planned major features for future updates. Which is also a reason why the codebase of Golf It! changes so drastically. One feature you may already heard of will be: Editor 2.0. To speed things up, we’ve also hired a new programmer to start working our new editor.

Take care,
Team Perfuse Entertainment

notes.title: Dev Log #2
notes.content:
[h1]Hey![/h1]
As we are still working on Update 1.0, we decided to release a series of dev logs to show you our progress and upcoming features. Our goal for this update is not only to release major features, but also to improve the overall quality of the game. That process takes more time than we expected, but we are constantly working to deliver the best experience.

[h2]Terrain Editing[/h2]
In our first dev log we would like to present to you a new editor tool. With Update 1.0 we will satisfy the long-desired request for a detailed landscape editor. This will happen on a voxel base which enables you to turn the boring flat terrain into whatever landscape you dream of.
[img]https://i.imgur.com/QA8QTda.gif[/img]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/lfimhVL.gif[/img]
The tool comes with different sculpture and painting modes and will be super easy to use – even on existing maps.
[img]https://i.imgur.com/eX5DtUW.gif[/img]

[h2]FAQ[/h2]
[b]Will Update 1.0 arrive by the end of 2022?[/b]
To be honest, we currently can’t tell. We are working hard to deliver the update as fast as possible, while achieving our self-imposed quality goals. We have reworked almost the entire codebase of Golf It! to make it as stable and future proof as possible. These measures were not planned at all, but as it turns out they were urgently necessary. From now on we will post dev logs on a regular base to keep you updated.

[b]Will Update 1.0 be the last update?[/b]
No. We have already planned major features for future updates. Which is also a reason why the codebase of Golf It! changes so drastically. One feature you may already heard of will be the Editor 2.0.

After months of work we are close to release our first VR build. Something many of you requested since we have launched our greenlight campaign. And there is even more new stuff going to be included in Update 0.8.0. [b]This update is all about preparation.[/b]

In order to deliver a better VR experience we had to update the version of our game engine. This time the update was awful, since it had a huge impact on the physical behavior of our game. [h2]So what is this update about?[/h2]
This “pre” update is all about quality assurance. After days of testing, we are confident that everything runs smoothly. The only uncertainty is the behavior of your setup. That is why [b]this update only contains the engine update and the following improvements[/b]:

[list]
[*]Significant collision improvements
[*]More consistent shooting behavior
[*]Scoreboard additions
[*]Spectator fixes

[/list]

If you encounter something broken, please tell us. The best way is to enter our Discord: https://discord.gg/perfuse

notes.title: Gravitation Update 0.5.2
notes.content:
Here it is, another huge update for Golf It!

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27663206/9bc1d5a29a6ef33a86d5972b2eff6f4062154833.gif[/img]

[h1]Gravitationzones[/h1]

A feature we've eagerly awaited since release is to change the gravitation based on zones.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27663206/95ca86fd90233a72052562f28dadee1d5df9ef17.gif[/img]

We're providing two different gravitation zones - a sphere and a cube. The cube will set the gravitation into a given direction. The sphere will set the gravitation in its center. If you set the gravity to 0 you will be in zero G and able to shoot in all directions.

[h1]Custom Music and Sounds[/h1]

We know you are utterly in love with our music - especially on graveyard. But in case you wanna create a specific mood on your custom map you can now import your own ogg music. You're designing a forest themed map? You may wanna import some atmospherical bird chirping. Suddenly the player gets teleported to a beautiful beach? You can use our eventsystem to change the music to whatever you want.

[h1]Eventsystem Enhancement[/h1]

We're really happy about the success of our eventsystem. There are already tons of use cases uploaded to the Workshop, which show us your inexhaustible creativity. Our goal is to restrict it as little as possible, therefore we are constantly extending the eventsystem.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27663206/8db902022c57f8d8da7938cbac03e11629d87ea2.gif[/img]

With this update the eventsystem gains control over some interesting map settings, for instance a dynamic day and night cycle. Besides the time of day you can change the theme of an asset, the background music or even the gravity. 

[h1]Our Discord[/h1]

We've created a Discord Server long time ago, but didn't tell anybody. Now is the time we are going to change that: https://discord.gg/TQqpYgR

First of all, thanks to every player and mapcreator - you are truly amazing.

notes.title: Winter Update 0.5.0
notes.content:
Winter has come to Golf it! and brings special Hats, Trails and Editor Items with it. For this update we've put our focus on improving the Editor and the overall game experience.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27663206/5ef30cfe440d9671919b2fa307333dddd8b6a12c.gif[/img]

[h1]Editor Update[/h1]

You don't wanna play these static maps any longer? We are happy to introduce the Eventsystem - one of the greatest features for the editor we've released so far!

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27663206/9a62a1d01778d27f76d21047dbb37434ad3ee21e.gif[/img]

The Eventsystem allows to create more dynamic maps than ever before. When a player enters or leaves an event zone dozens of actions can get triggered, which will affect lanes, meshes, rotators, lights, boosts, teleporter and so on. 

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27663206/963456e416d097afdf1979426066689166c698b5.gif[/img]

We have also added Forcefields to the editor, which can be used as magnets, gravitiy zones and much more. 

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27663206/7e17465477aa4fb74345a5e7080f5ffd4de4ddfd.gif[/img]

We are more than excited to see your dynamic map creations.

[h1]Game Refactoring[/h1]

One of our major concerns is to optimize features which are already in place. This time we've completely redesigned our golf ball mechanics, to make our gameplay more smooth and pleasant, but still being as skilled-based as before.

Another complete overhaul happend to our particle system, which means that we have heavily improved every single trail. So you may need to test every trail again to redefine your favorite one.

[h1]Special Thanks[/h1]

We would like to especially thank:

[b]YuNO[/b] for intensely testing our latest features and thereby pushing the quality of our game.
[b]ekomanic[/b] for creating an amazing custom asset pack. Please have a look at his discussion http://steamcommunity.com/app/571740/discussions/1/1499000547488188404/
[b]SecretShop[/b] for doing an excellent job as our first moderator.

Last but not least we want to thank all Map Creators for creating 1.784 custom Maps! [b]You are truly amazing[/b] - we are not going to stop making this editor unique and awesome.

[h1]What's coming next?[/h1]

- New Map and Scene
- Mac & Linux support
- Expanding the Eventsystem
- Expanded Controller Support
- Custom Sounds / Music
- Gravitationzones
- Keybinding
- VR Support
and more ;)

Take care and have a wonderful Christmas,

Christian & Jonas

notes.title: Dev Blog #1
notes.content:
[h1]Hey![/h1]

Here we are with our first blog post - one and a half exciting month after our early access release. First of all, we would like to thank you for being part of our small but fast growing community. We've received awesome feedback from you and we are amazed by your support. To be honest, when we released the game we didn't expect to receive so much positive feedback and it feels surreal to see that people already build over 200 golf courses.

[h1]Who are we?![/h1]

As some of you may already notice, the game was built as a one-man project. This will end soon when I'm going to hire Christian, who is a programmer and a good friend of mine. He is going to improve the performance of Golf it! and helps to implement new features. Furthermore, we are going to get our own assets to extend our world.

[h1]Our Focus[/h1]

We are currently focused on fixing bugs, which will result in multiple smaller updates. As soon as we are done with that, we are going to do more fancy stuff again, like implementing VR, better controller support and new worlds.

[h1]Mixed Reviews[/h1]

This morning we realized, that we are currently receiving negative reviews, which results in a "mixed reviews" label on our store page. This is a sign for us, that something is going wrong. This game was build because we wanted to have a golf game which is less casual and more based on skill. However, with our editor, we've reached a broader audience than we've expected and this audience is partly not interested in a non-casual game. We would love to receive feedback from you, so we get a better impression of your vision of the future.

[h1]YouTube and Twitch[/h1]

Golf it! has received a lot of coverage on YouTube and Twitch. There are videos with thousands of viewers which is awesome. Huge thanks, to all the people which are spreading video content about our game. We try to look as many videos as we can to gather feedback, to improve our game or just for fun.

[h1]TL;DR;[/h1]

 - Thanks for everything, we are amazed by your support. <3
 - The Team is growing +1.
 - Our Focus is on fixing bugs, VR, better controller support and new worlds.
 - Your feedback helps us to improve the game.

Take care,

Jonas & Christian

notes.title: Patch 0.4.0 - Dynamic Lanes
notes.content:
Patch notes for update 0.4.0:

- Updated Engine to 4.15.
- Added Dynamic Lanes to the editor.
- Major performance improvements on custom maps.
- Reduced host network load when playing custom maps.

- Fixed problem with muted music causing sound artifacts.
- Fixed issue where putter would spawn wrong when directly looking at the ball from above.
- Fixed ball not moving at the correct location while spectating.
- Fixed View-Distance settings not working on custom maps.

Quick introduction into Dynamic Lanes:

To activate and edit dynamic lanes rightclick on them.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27663206/af125fb1ce2b1ba677dc8dfa0134472d956bf6ed.gif[/img]

Use the the big hedra to change the distance from start to end point.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27663206/44e408301b9c8f7f625341473704649dd3d0469d.gif[/img]

Use the small hedras to change the tangents of the lanes.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27663206/bb3fe76e18d400b90dbe68647317be5c03a5890e.gif[/img]

When modifing the big hedras you can use your mouse wheel to roll the end points.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27663206/42f9ccc0816cc0e544acfac985520ec122f370fa.gif[/img]

Additional using SHIFT and mouse wheel lets you scale these points.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27663206/522fb0db0ac018bcd3e8c1a97d073dc7accf7a4d.gif[/img]
